utterance: Chloe, based on your symptoms and the test of your urine here, you have a simple urinary tract infection (cystitis). I've prescribed an antibiotic called Trimethoprim. You'll need to take one 300mg tablet once a day for 3 days. Make sure you finish the course. Also, try to drink plenty of water. You can get a urine alkaliser like Ural over the counter if the burning is really bad, which can help soothe it. I need you to come back or see a doctor urgently if you develop a fever, chills, back or side pain, nausea, or if your symptoms haven't improved after 2-3 days, as these can be signs that the infection has moved to your kidneys. Does that make sense, and do you have any questions?
reply: Yeah, that makes sense. I’ll take the tablets as prescribed and drink more water. I’ll come back if I get a fever or if it doesn’t get better. Thanks.
